messages:
jess: Heads up — saw an authz regression right after yesterday's KMS rekey. Tokens that should be scoped to `embeddings` were able to call `/v1/chat/completions` for ~4–6 minutes. Low volume but exploitable if unnoticed.

kai: yikes. timeline? which regions? any PII touched?

jess: Started ~2024-11-03T03:12Z (right when rekey finished). Only us-east-1 seen so far. No customer PII we can find in the few calls, mostly small test payloads.

jess: Audit snippet from audit-bot: `audit: token=sk_live_**** allowed route=/v1/chat/completions reason=scope_check_passed(scope=embeddings) keytag=kt_20241103 rekey=true`

kai: that log line looks wrong — scope_check_passed with scope=embeddings but route=chat. can you paste the raw header check log?

jess: raw: ```[11/03 03:14:22] authz: token_id=tok_123 scope_tags=[embeddings] allowed_routes=[/v1/embeddings] evaluated_against=allowlist_cache(keytag=kt_20241103) result=ALLOW``` then later ```[11/03 03:14:23] routing: selected_handler=/v1/chat/completions token_id=tok_123```

maria: hypothesis: cache-coherence issue — cache keyed by keytag produced by rekey but enforcement layer reads scope metadata from KMS using key id (or vice versa). during rekey we briefly had inconsistent metadata, so the allowlist lookup used stale mapping that included chat route as allowed.

dan: immediate mitigations: 1) block chat endpoints for tokens minted before rekey (easy temporary policy), 2) roll forward hotfix to make scope-enforcement authoritative (call KMS for key-id->scopes if cache miss), 3) emit metric for mismatched route vs scope to Pager duty.

kai: quick patch I propose (pseudocode): ```if allowlist_cache.hit == true and allowlist_cache.keytag != current_kms_keytag(token.key_id): // possible rekey race fallback_to_authoritative_check = true if fallback_to_authoritative_check: scopes = kms.get_scopes(token.key_id) verify_route_against(scopes)```

jess: created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/9999 (hotfix: cache key coherence + flush-on-rekey). assigned to @kai for review. rolling to canary now.

deploy-bot: hotfix deploy started: infra-hotswap/us-east-1 -> canary

audit-bot: alert created: "scope-enforcement-mismatch" count=1 window=5m severity=high

kai: reviewed, left a tiny nit. Can we also ensure KMS metadata version is included in token metadata moving forward (so scope checks can be purely local)?

jess: +1, added follow-up ticket to product-backlog. monitoring: add alert if audit:allowed_route != allowlist.expected_route > 0.1% for >10m.

deploy-bot: hotfix deployed to canary -> prod-us-east-1 completed (2024-11-03T03:28Z).

jess: closing loop: root cause = cache coherence during KMS rekey; fix = flush cache on rekey + authoritative fallback; follow-ups = include kms metadata in token and stronger audit alerting. assigning to @maria for postmortem write-up. :white_check_mark:
